text: WiNbreak2 125 is a compact moulded-case circuit breaker with thermal-magnetic protection for distribution panels.
WiNbreak2 250 supports adjustable overload protection and is offered in three-pole and four-pole variants.
WiNbreak2 400 Electronic provides an electronic trip unit for selective protection applications.
DP-Contactor 09 is intended for compact motor starters and frequent AC-3 switching.
DP-Contactor 18 is a general-purpose contactor with built-in normally-open and normally-closed auxiliary indication.
DP-Contactor 32 is designed for higher-duty motor switching and coordinated starter assemblies.
